Claim 26 (Currently amended): A non-transitory machine readable medium storing a program which when executed by at least one processing unit analyzes a document, the program comprising sets of instructions for: receiving a document that comprises a plurality of primitive graphic elements defined separately within the document, the document having a drawing order that indicates the order in which the primitive graphic elements are drawn when the document is displayed; calculating a first value for a first primitive graphic element and a second primitive graphic element that is subsequent to the first in the drawing order, wherein the first value is based on __spatial relationships between the first and second primitive graphic elements that are independent of character size and spacing properties__; and based on the comparison of the first value to other values calculated for additional primitive graphic elements that are subsequent in the drawing order, defining a single structural graphic element within the document from the first and second primitive graphic elements __only when the first value satisfies a predetermined threshold condition that distinguishes the grouping from character-level spacing analysis__.

Claim 27 (Currently amended): The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 26, wherein the first value is __a composite spatial metric comprising multiple geometric properties rather than a single size value__.

Claim 28 (Currently amended): The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 26, wherein the first value represents __a normalized spatial relationship metric derived from the smallest bounding box that encompasses the first and second primitive graphic elements, wherein the metric incorporates positional offsets between the elements__.

Claim 31 (Currently amended): The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 26, wherein the set of instructions for calculating comprises a set of instructions for calculating a different value for each pair of primitive graphic elements subsequent in the drawing order, wherein the set of instructions for defining the single structural graphic element comprises sets of instructions for: using the calculated values for pairs of primitive graphic elements to identify clusters of primitive graphic elements as candidates for joining as compound graphic elements __based on threshold-dependent spatial proximity analysis__; and identifying sequences of primitive graphic elements within a cluster whose bounding boxes intersect; and joining the sequences as single graphic elements __only when the spatial relationship satisfies criteria beyond simple overlap detection__.

Claim 32 (Currently amended): A non-transitory machine readable medium storing a program which when executed by at least one processing unit analyzes a document, the program comprising sets of instructions for: receiving a document that comprises a plurality of primitive graphic elements defined separately within the document; based on values calculated for pairs of primitive graphic elements __using spatial relationship metrics that distinguish compound graphic element identification from character-level analysis__, defining a set of successive primitive graphic elements as a candidate compound graphic element; using bounds of the primitive graphic elements in the cluster to identify one or more subsets of primitive graphic elements within the set; and defining each particular subset having more than one primitive graphic element as a single structural graphic element within the document, the structure graphic element comprising the primitive graphic elements in the particular subset.

Claim 33 (Original)

Claim 34 (Currently amended): The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 32, wherein the set of instructions for using bounds of the primitive graphic elements in the cluster to identify one or more subsets of primitive graphic elements comprises sets of instructions for: selecting a first graphic element in the cluster and assigning the graphic element to a new sub-cluster; assigning a second graphic element in the cluster to the sub-cluster when a bounding box of the second graphic element overlaps a bounding box of the sub-cluster __and when the overlap satisfies a minimum intersection threshold that indicates structural coherence__.
